input: Question example Q1: "Where is the payroll submission deadline stated?" Source inventory: PAY1 is the payroll handbook; ARC1 is an archived payroll note. Authority rule R1: PAY1 is the sole authority for payroll deadlines. Acceptable evidence: the payroll deadline statement in PAY1. Update dates: PAY1 was updated 2026-11-01; ARC1 was updated 2026-10-01. Fallback: HR1 is the supplied payroll contact if PAY1 is unavailable.

routes.question_pattern: Questions asking where the payroll submission deadline is stated
acceptable_evidence: The payroll deadline statement in PAY1

freshness_cue.note: The supplied update date is available; no maximum-age rule was supplied.

basis: R1 designates PAY1 as the sole authority for payroll deadlines.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: ARC1 was not treated as authoritative merely because it concerns payroll.
